strengths: All eight verbatim passages are preserved exactly, including the comet line that feeds 037's 'perihelion'.
The steamer arithmetic (30,000 halved back to 234 for 1835) and the 300 million tons are kept without invented figures.
The revision corrects the first draft's 'or suffer dissipation' back to the source's 'to suffer dissipation'.
The timid Paris gentleman and bombs-doubling sequence keeps its comic deflation of the cosmic register intact.
The closing run from contradiction and anti-law to 'it would need to jump' retains its rhythm.
summary: The revision keeps all eight verbatim anchors, the numbers, the comet/coal/squares/radium/new-American/jump arc, and all three planned dependencies. Its further cuts beyond the first draft remove several concessions and evidentiary links. The intensity difficulty is now raised and dropped, and the 'sequence' claim has no visible evidence. The 'any formula would do' hedge, science's own 'mental inertia', and the narrator's self-deprecating teacher persona are also gone. These are repairable editorial losses, not blockers.
